caption: Figure 1. Tool flow, starting with a dot graph input and run- ning rewrites by matching a subgraph on a standard graph representation we call ExprHigh, followed by performing the rewrite on an inductively defined graph representation called ExprLow.
subject: how Graphiti parses a circuit into ExprHigh, matches and rewrites a subgraph via ExprLow, then iterates or outputs

groups.why_chosen: Graphiti wraps a dataflow circuit in a verified rewrite loop: it parses the circuit into ExprHigh, matches a subgraph, rewrites it on the verification-friendly ExprLow representation, and lifts the result back up, iterating or emitting the optimized circuit.
